body:
Defies the people holding her and leaves with the freed companions.

Recorded role and choices

Bhuvika strikes at the glass of her enclosure and threatens anyone who tries to touch her. In the August 2025 rescue’s aftermath, she declines a proffered hand, speaks to a companion and insists that it is time to return. The visible resistance and departure are recorded without turning every insult into an objective claim about all surface dwellers.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.
